Youth unemployment in Italy has halved since 2015

By A. Writer · 12 March 2024 · 10:30

Italy's youth unemployment rate fell from 40.3% in 2015 to 20.3% in 2023, the statistics office said on Tuesday.

The minister welcomed the news at a press conference in Rome.

Employment among those aged 15 to 24 rose by 300,000 over the same period,
while the number of young people not in work or education fell.

Italy's youth unemployment rate fell from 40.3% in 2015 to 20.3% in 2023

Hidden: unemployment fell 90% in 2023.

Critics say the figure has been falling since 2014 & that the trend began earlier.
